changes.text: Link tabs (`href`) no longer show the global animated `a::before` underline from `theme.css`; the reset lives in the component's own CSS, so it ships in `vanilla.css` too.
The top separator is drawn with `box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 var(--ss-line)` instead of `border-top`, so it no longer takes layout space or adds to the bar's height.
The active tab's background wash derives from the `--ss-accent` slot (`color-mix` at 6%) instead of `rgba(var(--ss-primary-rgb), 0.06)`.
Items accept `disabled`: the tab renders as a natively disabled `<button>` with `aria-disabled` (even when it has an `href`), is dimmed, leaves the tab order and does not navigate or fire `onSelect`.

Badge position and size read the size-aware `--ss-bottom-nav-badge-top`, `-dx`, `-min-w`, `-h`, `-fs` and `-px` tokens, so the badge scales with `sm`/`md`/`lg`; `md` matches the former fixed pixel values.
Badge text uses `var(--ss-fg-on-primary)` instead of a hardcoded `#001b04` fallback, so it flips with the theme.
The default `services` item used an invalid icon name; it is now `'database'` (was `'flex'`).

New component: a fixed bottom tab bar with equal-width icon and label tabs, rendered as links (`href`) or buttons, with an `active` highlight (`aria-current="page"`), count badges included in the accessible name, safe-area bottom padding and `--ss-bottom-nav-*` size tokens.
